items.title: Flight Attendants Union Chief Targets Regional Pay, Delta, and Worker Data
items.snippet: Skift Take: The era of catch-up flight attendant raises is ending, but airlines shouldn’t expect labor costs to ease. The next fights are over regional pay and worker data. Flight attendants and pilots saw massive pay jumps in recent negotiations. Association of Flight Attendants International President Sara Nelson doesn’t expect a repeat.

items.title: Manhattan’s Elysée New York set to reopen after monthslong renovation
items.snippet: The historic hotel will remain home to Monkey Bar and offer new culinary and wellness amenities as the flagship property of Hera Hospitality Group’s Wunderkind Hotels & Resorts.

items.title: From Booking to Check-In: How to Make the Most of Travel Tuesday
items.snippet: A tactical guide for hoteliers on maximising Travel Tuesday, covering distribution, rate protection, mobile check-in, guest messaging, and upselling to convert discount bookings into higher-value stays.

items.title: EIH Hotels revises Trident Tirupati project cost to Rs 344 crore
items.snippet: EIH Hotels Ltd has revised the planned capital expenditure for its proposed Trident hotel in Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh, to Rs 344 crore through its wholly owned subsidiary, Svara Hotels Ltd. The project is expected to become operational by March 2030. The revised investment follows an exchange of land allotted to Svara Hotels (formerly Mumtaz Hotels) by the Andhra Pradesh government.

items.title: Aman Enlists Djokovic for New Ultra-Luxury Wellness and Sports Retreat
items.snippet: Developed in collaboration with tennis star Novak Djokovic, the performance-led wellness brand will debut in Miami's Brickell district.

items.title: ‘Hydration emerges as a key part of premium hospitality experience’:Jagriti Motwani, AUM Premium
items.snippet: AUM Premium is targeting India’s hospitality sector to drive growth in the premium bottled water segment, with plans to build partnerships across hotels, restaurants and wellness establishments. The brand, which offers niche Himalayan spring water, Glow Water and an affirmation-led bottle collection, is banking on rising consumer interest in wellness and premium hydration to build its market presence.

items.title: Amidst adverse conditions, GNTO expects to end the year on a growth note
items.snippet: Although the decadal high of 961,656 Indian overnights to Germany recorded in 2019 is still far-fetched, the German National Tourism Organisation (GNTO) India Office is hopeful of ending the year on a positive note.

items.title: Maharashtra beaches earn international Blue Flag Certification
items.snippet: Maharashtra has achieved an important milestone in sustainable tourism, with three of its beaches receiving the internationally recognised Blue Flag certification for the 2026–27 season. The newly certified beaches are Ladghar and Guhagar in Ratnagiri district and Shrivardhan in Raigad district. This is the first time beaches from Maharashtra have received this recognition.

items.title: Kerzner International to debut rare finds in Asia with Vana Som Botanical Resort in Chiang Mai
items.snippet: Kerzner International has announced the development of Vana Som Botanical Resort in Mae Rim, Chiang Mai, marking the debut of its rare finds collection in Asia and the brand’s first property in Thailand. Scheduled to open in 2029, the resort will combine luxury hospitality, branded residences and cultural experiences inspired by Northern Thailand’s heritage.

items.title: Thomas Cook India CFO looks to recoup travel business shortfall through margin management, digital push
items.snippet: Brijesh Modi says the company is focusing on cost management, procurement efficiencies and automation to protect margins amid geopolitical disruptions and rising travel costs; holiday business forward bookings rise 30% year on year.
